data.name: Manaal
data.gender_notes: Manaal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: From the root MAN (to be in a state of worship)
data.long_meaning: A name that signifies devotion, dedication, and closeness to Allah. The name Manaal carries the meaning “From the root MAN (to be in a state of worship)” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manaal usually hope their child will grow to embody from the root man (to be in a state of worship) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Manaal is associated with the concept of Tawhid, the oneness of Allah.
data.etymology: Manaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “From the root MAN (to be in a state of worship).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manaal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
